query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:22:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T19:42:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (url.original LIKE "*.sh" OR url.original LIKE "*script*" OR url.original LIKE "*bin*" OR url.original LIKE "*pipe*" OR url.original LIKE "*download*")
| KEEP @timestamp, url.original, source.ip, user_agent.original, http.request.method
| SORT @timestamp ASC
